claim: Buys resolution after the diffusion pass, so a hero shot can carry the line detail that survives a big screen while a two-second cutaway stays cheap. Reach for it only on shots held long enough for the audience to inspect them; upscaling everything multiplies render time for detail nobody sees at cut speed.
not_visual: Post-generation resolution pass, not a prompt input. With the subject sentence and seed fixed the prompt is byte-identical across all four values, so every panel is the same image at a different pixel count. Tags like 'absurdres' or 'highres' would fake it by asking the model for a different, busier drawing, which is not what an upscaler does. Compare it instead by rendering one seed and running the upscaler at each factor, inspected at 100% - a resolution test, not a capability card.
